title: Born next to the Army's first nuclear test reactor

tellings.quote: reactor that the Army had spun up uh and

plain: John Blitch, a former DARPA scientist (DARPA is the Pentagon's research agency), says he was born in Idaho Falls, Idaho, close to the first nuclear test reactor the Army had "spun up," and grew up there between 1950 and 1963. He tells Michels this about his own childhood, a backdrop to the strange experiences he describes later in life.
